certification.name: Infosec Python for Cybersecurity Specialization
certification.description: Five-course Infosec specialization on writing Python scripts to automate offensive and defensive security tasks, organised around MITRE ATT&CK and Shield use cases. Course-based certificate assessed through coding projects, with no proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 4 weeks at 10 hours a week.
